units.source_text: 我看这首诗作得很不错呢！”

en.t: I think this poem is very well composed!"
He said this with a broad smile on his face.

units.source_text: 原来此人不懂恋歌赠答之事，而是初次尝试。

en.t: It turned out that he knew nothing about exchanging love poems and was trying it for the first time.

units.source_text: 乳母老太太被他缠得头昏脑涨，作不出答诗了，便叫两个女儿代作。

en.t: The old nurse was so pestered by him that her head was spinning; unable to compose a reply poem, she asked her two daughters to write one for her.
Her daughters said, "We are even less able to compose one!"

units.source_text: 乳母老太太觉得久不答复，不成体统，想到就算，便答吟道：

en.t: The old nurse felt that leaving him unanswered for so long would be improper, so she decided that anything she could think of would have to do and chanted in reply:
